lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: priu sahaj subhaaee chhod na jaaee man laagaa ra(n)g majeethaa ||
lines.translation: My Beloved shall not leave me to go anywhere - this is His natural way; my mind is imbued with the lasting color of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਧੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har naanak bedhe charan kamal kichh aan na meethaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Lotus Feet of the Lord have pierced Nanak's mind, and now, nothing else seems sweet to him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu raatee jal maachhulee tiu raam ras maate raam raaje ||
lines.translation: Just like the fish which revels in water, I am intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, my Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਭਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa jeevan gat bhaate raam raaje ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, and blessed me with salvation in my life; I love the Lord, my King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan gat suaamee a(n)tarajaamee aap leee laR laae ||
lines.translation: The Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts, blesses me with salvation in my life; He Himself attaches me to His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਪਰਗਟੋ ਪੂਰਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ratan padaaratho paragato poorano chhod na katahoo jaae ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the treasure of jewels, the perfect manifestation; He shall not forsake us to go anywhere else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh sughar saroop sujaan suaamee taa kee mitai na daate ||
lines.translation: God, the Lord Master, is so accomplished, beauteous, and all-knowing; His gifts are never exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jal sa(n)g raatee maachhulee naanak har maate ||2||
lines.translation: As the fish is enraptured by the water, so is Nanak intoxicated by the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boo(n)d jiu har praan adhaaraa raam raaje ||
lines.translation: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, the Lord, the Lord my King, is the Support of my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maal khajeenaa sut bhraat meet sabhahoo(n) te piaaraa raam raaje ||
lines.translation: My Lord King is more beloved than all wealth, treasure, children, siblings and friends.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhahoo(n) te piaaraa purakh niraaraa taa kee gat nahee jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: The absolute Lord, the Primal Being, is more beloved than all; His condition cannot be known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saas giraas na bisarai kabahoo(n) gurasabadee ra(n)g maaneeai ||
lines.translation: I shall never forget the Lord, for an instant, for a single breath; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਸੰਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨੋ ਜਪਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh purakh jagajeevano sa(n)t ras peevano jap bharam moh dukh daaraa ||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord God is the Life of the Universe; His Saints drink in the Lord's sublime essence. Meditating on Him, doubts, attachments and pains are shaken off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boo(n)d jiu naanak har piaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, so does Nanak love the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mile naraain aapane maanoratho pooraa raam raaje ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Lord, my Lord King, my desires are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਠੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaathee bheet bhara(n)m kee bhetat gur sooraa raam raaje ||
lines.translation: The walls of doubt have been torn down, meeting the Brave Guru, O Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਾਏ ਸਭ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran gur paae purab likhaae sabh nidh deen daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny; God is the Giver of all treasures - He is merciful to the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh soee su(n)dar gur gopaalaa ||
lines.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, is God, the most beautiful Guru, the Sustainer of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanere patit paavan saadhoo dhooraa ||
lines.translation: The dust of the feet of the Holy purifies sinners, and brings great joy, bliss and ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har mile naraain naanakaa maanorathou pooraa ||4||1||3||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Infinite Lord, has met with Nanak, and his desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau bhae kripaal prabh har har seee japaat ||
lines.translation: Those beings, unto whom the Lord God shows His Mercy, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak preet lagee tinh raam siu bhetat saadh sa(n)gaat ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they embrace love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਨਿਆਈ ਰੀਤਿ ਅਬ ਦੁਧ ਆਚ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal dudh niaaee reet ab dudh aach nahee man aisee preet hare ||
lines.translation: Just like water, which loves milk so much that it will not let it burn - O my mind, so love the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲੇਹ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab urajhio al kamaleh baasan maahi magan ik khin bhee naahi tarai ||
lines.translation: The bumble bee becomes enticed by the lotus, intoxicated by its fragrance, and does not leave it, even for a moment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੀਐ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੀਐ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin naahi tareeai preet hareeai seegaar habh ras arapeeai ||
lines.translation: Do not let up your love for the Lord, even for an instant; dedicate all your decorations and pleasures to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਤਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dookh suneeai jam pa(n)th bhaneeai tah saadhasa(n)g na darapeeai ||
lines.translation: Where painful cries are heard, and the Way of Death is shown, there, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not be afraid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar keerat govi(n)d guneeai sagal praachhat dukh hare ||
lines.translation: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and all sins and sorrows shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak chha(n)t govi(n)d har ke man har siu nehu karehu aisee man preet hare ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and enshrine love for the Lord; love the Lord this way in your mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee machhulee neer ik khin bhee naa dheere man aisaa nehu karehu ||
lines.translation: As the fish loves the water, and is not content even for an instant outside it, O my mind, love the Lord in this way.
